claims.claim: Queries the macOS System Events dark-mode preference with osascript, recognizes only trimmed true output as dark, and treats command errors as light.
At session start, removes earlier polling and returns without an appearance check when the session has no interactive UI.
Maps each appearance result to a dark or light Pi theme and calls the theme setter only when that selection differs from the previous one.
Runs one theme check immediately, schedules later checks every two seconds, and unreferences the polling timer.
Registers polling cleanup for session shutdown; cleanup clears an active interval and resets its stored handle.
